audit.whatIsWrong: Nevermove is labelled (W) in five places and the 'slow W cast' is described as the root.
audit.why: Swain's W is Vision of Empire, a long-range demon eye that damages, slows and reveals. Nevermove is E — the wave that travels out, returns, roots what it hits, and lets him pull rooted champions in.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected; the root is Nevermove (E, 12s at rank 1) and the eye is Vision of Empire (W, 22s at rank 1).

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells the player Wind Wall eats Death's Hand bolts.
audit.why: Only Nevermove carries the projectile flag in Swain's kit; Death's Hand has no flag at all, which the brief's rules say means UNKNOWN, not confirmed. Building the lane plan on walling the Q is unsafe advice, and the root is the ability that actually decides the trade — it also returns to Swain, so the wall can catch it on either leg.
audit.corrected: Hold Wind Wall (25s at rank 1) for the Nevermove root; that is the engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ravenous Flock is never mentioned in either layer.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags Swain twice: he sustains through chip damage (Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades) and he bypasses stacking resistances, because Soul Fragments heal him and permanently raise his maximum health. Poking him without anti-heal feeds him.
audit.corrected: Every Soul Fragment heals him and adds permanent health — buy Grievous Wounds before you contest a drain fight.

audit.why: Death's Hand 7s at rank 1 down to 3s, Vision of Empire 22s, Nevermove 12s at rank 1, Demonic Ascension a flat 120s that persists as long as he drains champions. Wind Wall 25s at rank 1 for a 4-second wall.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, the spikes and mid.

audit.why: The mirror set row 0 to Skill and rows 2, 3 and 5 to Swain. mirror-fix.js would overwrite any disagreement I left.
audit.corrected: Those four rows realigned as matched full/content pairs with inverse ratings.

edits.after: Swain spikes here: Soul Fragments have stacked permanent health, so raw burst no longer finishes him — carry Grievous Wounds, wall the Nevermove (E) root, and take the fight only on its 12s cooldown, never into a fresh one.
